TAL_YIN_BORROWED_CONSEQUENCE.name: Borrowed Consequence
TAL_YIN_BORROWED_CONSEQUENCE.why: Actual Diminish Force reduction receipt grants half as source-tracked Temporary HP; explicit Yang provenance or the three printed damage types adds PB.

TAL_YIN_RETURN_THE_OVEREXTENSION.name: Return the Overextension
TAL_YIN_RETURN_THE_OVEREXTENSION.why: Optional paid retaliation consumes the actual reduction, capped at three times CL, without another mark or action.

TAL_YIN_STILL_THE_BRIGHT_STRIKE.name: Still the Bright Strike
TAL_YIN_STILL_THE_BRIGHT_STRIKE.why: Successful Force/Aim mark consumption applies a native timed speed penalty; normal speed calculation clamps at zero.
